constraints.name: appointment_mutations_revision_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((expected_revision >= 0) AND (expected_revision = observed_revision) AND (result_revision >= 0) AND (((outcome = 'APPLIED'::text) AND (observed_revision < '9223372036854775807'::bigint) AND ((result_revision - observed_revision) = 1) AND (effect_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (effect_revision = result_revision)) OR ((outcome = 'NO_CHANGE'::text) AND (expected_revision = result_revision) AND (effect_revision IS NULL) AND (before_image = after_image) AND (before_resource_ids = after_resource_ids) AND (allowed_fields = '{}'::text[])))))

constraints.name: appointment_mutations_shape_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((origin = ANY (ARRAY['V2'::text, 'V1_CLOSE'::text])) AND (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['APPLIED'::text, 'NO_CHANGE'::text])) AND (command = ANY (ARRAY['STATUS'::text, 'NOTES'::text, 'RESCHEDULE'::text, 'RESIZE'::text, 'REASSIGN_STAFF'::text, 'REASSIGN_LOCATION'::text, 'RESOURCES'::text, 'SERVICE_CORRECTION'::text, 'CANCEL'::text, 'REASSIGN_CUSTOMER'::text])) AND (reason = btrim(reason)) AND ((char_length(reason) >= 1) AND (char_length(reason) <= 500)) AND (jsonb_typeof(request) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(before_image) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(after_image) = 'object'::text) AND (COALESCE(array_ndims(before_resource_ids), 1) = 1) AND (COALESCE(array_ndims(after_resource_ids), 1) = 1) AND (array_position(before_resource_ids, NULL::uuid) IS NULL) AND (array_position(after_resource_ids, NULL::uuid) IS NULL) AND (array_position(allowed_fields, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND isfinite(created_at)))
